description: A metal drying rack sits on the right side of the green counter with four plastic cups inside it: red, yellow, blue, and green. The right hand reaches into the rack, grips the red cup and lifts it out to set it upright on the counter, then removes the yellow cup and places it beside the red, followed by the blue cup set in front; finally, the right hand grabs the green cup and lifts it out of the rack toward the other cups.
